title: 10 Most Dangerous Towns in Texas You Should Never Move To  | Worst Texas Cities  to Live in 2026
description:
Texas. The Lone Star State. Known for its wide-open skies, booming cities, and southern charm. But behind the beauty lies a darker truth. Some Texas towns carry reputations that are hard to ignore — high crime rates, unsafe streets, and communities struggling with violence.

In today’s video, we’re counting down the 10 Most Dangerous Towns in Texas, 2025. Whether you’re planning a move or just curious, you’ll want to stick around… because some of these names might surprise you.
